Frequently Asked Questions

Does Travelers Rest really need different HVAC sizing than Greenville proper?

The load calculation usually says so, yes. The escarpment edge runs cooler nights and a longer heating season, which shifts the design balance toward heating capacity compared with an identical house downtown. Equipment sized off metro assumptions tends to run short exactly when winters lean on it.

We bought an older cottage near downtown. What should get inspected first?

The systems age hides best: wiring condition, supply plumbing material, and the heating equipment’s combustion safety. A multi-trade inspection documents all three with priorities ranked, so renovation money goes to what the house actually needs first rather than what shows.

Why does my well water stain fixtures even though it tastes fine?

Staining and taste track different minerals, so one can be present without the other. Iron and manganese stain at concentrations below what most people taste. A water test measures what is actually present, and the treatment system gets matched to those numbers rather than to a symptom.

How long do power outages typically last in the foothills compared to town?

Longer, as a pattern: fewer customers per line means restoration crews reach these feeders later, and tree exposure means more damage per storm. That gap is the practical case for standby generators up here, and the load calculation sizes one to whatever coverage level the household wants.

Which communities near Travelers Rest do you serve?

Marietta, Slater-Marietta, and Berea ride the same northern routes. The chat team can confirm any address up the corridor.
